title: Highland Cloud Forest Terrarium Control System — open-source weather-mimicking climate controller
description: Complete design files, control flows, firmware, dashboards, and analysis scripts for an open-source environmental control system that simulates tropical highland cloud-forest climates in an enclosed terrarium. The system ingests real-time Colombian highland weather with a time-zone-aware phase shift, drives a marine-compressor cooling loop and a raised-cosine LED photoperiod, and runs entirely on Node-RED, InfluxDB and Grafana on a Raspberry Pi with an Arduino Mega for hardware I/O. This archive accompanies the HardwareX engineering paper and the companion horticultural papers (Carnivorous Plant Newsletter, Orchids/AOS, ICPS).
